name: Ranger
rootCause: The Ranger project on the BSC chain was an exit scam, and the Ranger token fell by 95%. The contract deployer sent the tokens to an external account, which was then sold for a profit of about $77,000. Do not confuse this project with similarly named tokens and symbols, refer to the contract address: bsc: 0xc9efd09c8170e5ce43219967a0564a9b610e5ea2.
